title: Adding engine hours
description: Record engine hours so intervals and planning stay accurate.

steps.text: Open your boat and go to the Log tab.
Tap to add hours with the current odometer or hour-meter reading.
AftLog stores the total and keeps it current.
Update it whenever you run the engine.

tips: Total hours drive interval due-dates and the fuel-range brain.
Start a GPS trip to log hours automatically.
affects: Feed the dashboard, intervals, and cost insights.
examples: Recording 250 hours after the instrument service.
